policy: kill first; SPAN_UNDERIVED candidates are ineligible (R377 evidence-derivation requirement); R397 Phase 2: DOES_NOT_BEAT_BASELINE and PLAUSIBILITY_BOUND_VIOLATED candidates are ineligible for release (the machine's own physics gates the claim); among survivors prefer better E15-B verdict, then BEATS_BASELINE, then fewer deficient areas, then fewer UNCERTAIN attack outcomes; NO numeric score is computed (CEO standing rule: no new scoring systems)

ranked.mechanism: Utilization of diametric magnets in cochlear implant designs to mitigate MRI-related dislodgment, migration, and expulsion.
ranked.intervention: Implement diametric magnet configurations in the device's magnetic coupling systems to enhance retention during high-field exposure.

ranked.mechanism: Diametric magnet configuration in cochlear implants significantly reduces MRI-related adverse events like dislodgment and migration compared to previous designs
ranked.intervention: Implement diametric magnet shielding or configuration in magnetic actuator or sensor components of the medical device to ensure stability under external magnetic fields or mechanical stress

ranked.mechanism: Utilization of diametric magnets in device design to mitigate MRI-related adverse events, specifically reducing dislodgment and migration associated with static magnetic fields.
ranked.intervention: Replace or design standard permanent magnets in the medical device housing with diametrically magnetized magnets or passive magnetic shielding materials to minimize net stray fields and torque interactions during MRI exposure.

ranked.mechanism: Use of diametric magnets in cochlear implants to reduce MRI-related adverse events such as magnet dislodgment, dislocation, migration, and expulsion during magnetic resonance imaging.
ranked.intervention: Integrate diametrically magnetized components (or a diametric magnet assembly) into the implantable medical device so that the internal magnet experiences reduced torque and force when the patient undergoes MRI, thereby lowering the risk of magnet dislodgment/dislocation and migration/expulsion.

selection_basis.mechanism: Utilization of diametric magnets in cochlear implant designs to mitigate MRI-related dislodgment, migration, and expulsion.
selection_basis.intervention: Implement diametric magnet configurations in the device's magnetic coupling systems to enhance retention during high-field exposure.
